basic_details.job_title: PAU Junior Field/Lab Helper (Soil Science) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Soil Science, Punjab Agricultural University (PAU), Ludhiana, has invited applications on plain paper for two posts of Junior Field/Lab Helper at a fixed salary of Rs.13486+800/- (EPF+ESI) per month, fixed initially for six months. Applications must be sent to the office of the Head, Department of Soil Science, on or before 30 November 2026, with a Rs.100 demand draft and attested copies of certificates. Applicants appear before the Selection Committee on 9 December 2026 at 11.30 a.m.

Tenure: the salary is fixed initially for a period of six months, provided in the scheme. | Candidates should refer to the official notice for any further detail on eligibility.

content_sections.heading: About PAU Department of Soil Science
content_sections.text: Punjab Agricultural University is a university in Ludhiana, Punjab. This notice comes from its Department of Soil Science and is for posts under the scheme "Studies on the performance of Nanofertilizers on productivity of different cropping systems Misc-63 (PC-5462)".

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The notice asks candidates to send the application, complete in all respects, to the office of the Head, Department of Soil Science, Punjab Agricultural University, Ludhiana, on or before 30-11-2026. The notice does not print a PIN code, a postal mode or an envelope superscription. Write the application on plain paper giving name, address, age, educational qualifications, experience etc. Enclose a demand draft of Rs.100/- in favor of Comptroller, PAU, Ludhiana as fee charges. Enclose attested copies of certificates. Send the application to the office of the Head, Department of Soil Science, PAU, Ludhiana by 30-11-2026. Appear before the Selection Committee on 09-12-2026 at 11.30 a.m. with original copies of the testimonials. The University is not responsible for any postal delay or loss in transit.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational qualification: Middle with Punjabi. Age limit: between 18 to 63 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and lists no age relaxation. Preference: candidates who have been working as DPLs in the respective field in PAU for 10 years will be given preference. Fee: Rs.100/- by demand draft in favor of Comptroller, PAU, Ludhiana. Tenure: the salary is fixed initially for a period of six months, provided in the scheme. Candidates should refer to the official notice for any further detail on eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application on plain paper with name, address, age, educational qualifications, experience etc. Demand draft of Rs.100/- in favor of Comptroller, PAU, Ludhiana. Attested copies of certificates. Original copies of the testimonials, to be brought to the Selection Committee on 09-12-2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates appear before the Selection Committee in the office of the undersigned, the Head, Department of Soil Science, on 9 December 2026 at 11.30 a.m., along with original copies of the testimonials. The notice does not describe any written test or other stage.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received after the due date, or without the application fee, shall not be considered. No TA/DA will be given for the Selection Committee day. The services of the incumbent are liable to be terminated at any time without any notice. The engagement is for the scheme named in the notice, with the salary fixed initially for six months.

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Field/Lab Helper posts has PAU announced?
faq.answer: The PAU Department of Soil Science notice is for the engagement of two posts of Junior Field/Lab Helper.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for PAU Junior Field/Lab Helper?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 November 2026. Applications received after the due date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for PAU Junior Field/Lab Helper?
faq.answer: The qualification is Middle with Punjabi.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is between 18 to 63 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a PAU Junior Field/Lab Helper?
faq.answer: The fixed salary is Rs.13486+800/- (EPF+ESI) per month, fixed initially for a period of six months.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.100/-, paid by demand draft in favor of Comptroller, PAU, Ludhiana. Applications received without the fee will not be considered.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Write an application on plain paper with name, address, age, educational qualifications and experience, attach the demand draft and attested certificates, and send it to the Head, Department of Soil Science, PAU, Ludhiana by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. When and where is the Selection Committee?
faq.answer: Candidates appear before the Selection Committee on 9 December 2026 at 11.30 a.m. in the office of the Head, Department of Soil Science, with original copies of the testimonials.

faq.question: Q9. Is TA/DA paid for attending the Selection Committee?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be given for that day.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: The salary is fixed initially for six months under a scheme, and the notice says the services are liable to be terminated at any time without any notice.
